motion: Does consciousness fundamentally pervade reality and point toward God?

moves.currentDescription: Panentheism places God in everything and everything in God, with material reality existing within a field of consciousness.
moves.lockedProposition: Panentheism places God in everything and everything in God, with material reality existing within a field of consciousness.
moves.completeLockedSourceExcerpt: um when it comes to talking about God, whatever else I might be I'm a panentheist. Um not a pantheist. A pantheist, of course, believes that the sum of everything is God. I don't believe God can be so easily summed up. I believe that God is in everything and that everything exists in God. And I believe that consciousness is in whatever form part of matter throughout the cosmos, not completely distinct from from matter and that everything material exists in a field of consciousness.

moves.currentDescription: Perceptual consciousness is the brain's constrained construction rather than direct access to things as they are.
moves.lockedProposition: Perceptual consciousness is the brain's constrained construction rather than direct access to things as they are.
moves.completeLockedSourceExcerpt: where our perceptual experience is constructed. It's it's the result of an ongoing process that between the world and and the brain. The brain is of course part of the world too. Um But what we experience is a is the brain's best guess of what's what's going on that is constrained by sensory signals, information coming from the world. We do not experience things as they are. We experience them as we are.
